#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstring>
#define LL long long
using namespace std;
const int N=65;
const int mod=1e9+7;
int m,len;
LL n,v[N];
struct node
{
	int v[35][35];
	node(){memset(v,0,sizeof(v));}
}S,T[N][35],s1[N][35],s2[N][35];
node operator * (node a,node b)
{
	node c;
	for(int i=0;i<=m;i++)
		for(int j=0;j<=m;j++)
			for(int k=0;k<=m;k++)
				c.v[i][j]=(c.v[i][j]+1ll*a.v[i][k]*b.v[k][j]%mod)%mod;
	return c;
}
int main()
{
	cin>>n>>m;
	v[0]=n;while(v[len])v[len+1]=v[len]/m,v[len]%=m,len++;
	for(int i=0;i<len;i++)
	{
		if(!i)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<m;j++)
			{
				T[i][j].v[m][m]=1;
				for(int a=0;a<m;a++)
				{
					if(a!=j){T[i][j].v[a][a]=1;continue;}
					for(int b=0;b<=m;b++)T[i][j].v[a][b]=1;
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			for(int j=0;j<m;j++)
				if(!j)T[i][j]=s2[i-1][0];
				else T[i][j]=s2[i-1][j]*s1[i-1][j-1];
		}
		s1[i][0]=T[i][0];
		for(int j=1;j<m;j++)s1[i][j]=s1[i][j-1]*T[i][j];
		s2[i][m-1]=T[i][m-1];
		for(int j=m-2;j>=0;j--)s2[i][j]=T[i][j]*s2[i][j+1];
	}
	for(int i=0;i<=m;i++)S.v[0][i]=1;
	for(int i=len-1,j=0;i>=0;i--)
		while(v[i]--)S=S*T[i][j],j=(j+1)%m;
	cout<<S.v[0][m];
	return 0;
}
